description: 33% of girls marry before 18 and about 11% before 15. By state: Jigawa 63%, Zamfara 63%, Sokoto 61%, Katsina 61%. A 2026 study reports 80% in northern Nigeria, with marriage rates of 86% among adolescent girls in control communities.
energy_note: Nearly two in three girls, in four states.

description: 48% in rural areas against 16% urban. 67% in the poorest wealth quintile against 6% in the richest. 66.7% of women with no formal education against 13% of those who completed higher education.
energy_note: Eleven times more likely if you are poor.

description: Section 29(4) of the 1999 Constitution sets the age of maturity at 18, but section 29(4)(b) provides that a girl child reaches maturity on marriage, regardless of age. An attempt to delete it failed when the recommendation did not obtain the two-thirds needed for amendment.
energy_note: Adult at eighteen, or on marriage, whichever comes first.
notes: The clause has been in the Constitution since 1979 and its operative scope concerns renunciation of citizenship; the failed deletion vote was not a vote to legalise child marriage. Recorded precisely because the distinction is usually lost.

aspect: And the Marriage Act sets no minimum age at all
description: The federal Child Rights Act bans child marriage, but the Marriage Act specifies no minimum, and the Child Rights Act must be domesticated state by state - which the highest-prevalence states have not done.
energy_note: Three statutes, and the strictest one does not apply where it is needed.

aspect: It is the upstream cause of several other issues here
description: Early marriage ends schooling (EDU-002), produces the obstructed labour in MAT-002, removes the independent income that would make divorce possible, and sets the household bargaining position for forty years.
energy_note: One year's decision, forty years of consequence.

aspect: Something does work: the community intervention
description: A 2026 Nature study reported a big-push community intervention that reduced rates of child marriage by 80%. The problem is not that nothing works.
energy_note: Eighty per cent reduction, demonstrated, in a trial.
